text: The Nominating Panel – Corporations will select candidates to be interviewed and nominated at its July 9, 2019 meeting for appointment by City Council to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board.

The Corporations Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its July 9, 2019 meeting for appointment to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board: MTC1-9 MTC1-10 MTC2-5 MTC2-6 MTC2-8 MTC2-9 MTC2-24 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (June 6, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Metro Toronto Convention Centre Board.
